name: Tin Street Market
description: A bustling, chaotic bazaar in the Tenth District of Ravnica, a hub of trade, crime and intrigue.

description_citations.text: "Tin Street Market". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska invites Jace to a date at Tin Street Market and he accepts.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The narrator recounts being recruited from Tin Street by a vedalken who asks if he is happy.
timeline.quote: Anyways, the Vedalken finally asks me if I'm happy.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "24 Dhazo 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Riding Ashmane through Tin Street Market, Modar hears a man's last cry and finds blood in an alley.
timeline.quote: Even before he saw the crumpled body, Modar caught sight of dark, rolling lines of blood.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Two". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Modar finds a woman in Boros uniform standing over an ogre's corpse, her hands dripping with blood.
timeline.quote: A woman in Boros uniform stood over an enormous corpse

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Two". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The shapeshifter takes the exact form of the dead ogre when Modar tries to stop her.
timeline.quote: she had taken the exact form of the victim

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Two". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Modar stabs the shapeshifter with his gladius but is struck on the cheek and loses his binding spell.
timeline.quote: Modar leaned in with the gladius, still hum-singing, and sank the blade up to the haft just below the ribcage.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Modar slows the shapeshifter with a knight's charm, summons Ashmane, and tears his brooch free to escape.
timeline.quote: Just before the slow-spell ended, Modar reached out and tore the brooch free, and was off.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Returning to the alley, Modar finds the body and blood gone.
timeline.quote: the body was gone and the blood had vanished.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Five". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Modar announces from the market stage that he is investigating deaths and has been given the rank of imperator, repeating his name to bait the shapeshifter.
timeline.quote: Then he repeated it again, and spelled his name clearly.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Six". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The shapeshifter, now a troll, seizes Modar by the throat with Modar's own gladius at his chin.
timeline.quote: The troll grinned, produced a blade, and tucked it right under Modar's chin: it was Modar's gladius, clutched by the shapeshifter's gleaming black claws.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Six". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An Azorius arrest team led by the district imperator tears the tent apart as Modar pulls the shapeshifter's claws into his chest while it takes his form.
timeline.quote: as the shapeshifter's bones began to rearrange themselves into the anatomy of a vedalken knight

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Six". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos and Feather publicly arrest Mr. Gullmott on stage during a production of the Signing of the Guildpact, and Yertrude vanishes from the audience, returning as a seeker ghost that Kos destroys.
timeline.quote: Kos and Feather very publicly arrested Mr. Gullmott while he was enraged and enchanted on-stage in a production of the Signing of the Guildpact .

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years later Fonn investigates the murder of shop owner Zuza Uldossa, whose body is examined by Dr. Helligan, a Lupul in disguise.
timeline.quote: Fonn investigated another murder on the street, this time of shop owner Zuza Uldossa

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Modar Bejiri lets a doppelganger kill him and take his shape just as the arresting Azorius soldiers arrive.
timeline.quote: Modar let himself be killed by the creature who then took on his shape

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guildless ogre Ritjit rampages through the market, destroying 81% of the stalls before being detained.
timeline.quote: he destroyed 81% of the Tin Street Market stalls in less than twenty minutes.

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ritjit escapes his cell by smashing the door with the iron ball chained to his foot.
timeline.quote: He spent three years in a cell before smashing the door with the iron ball chained to his foot.

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Tin Street fills with celebrations and Araithia Shokta cries in an alley.
timeline.quote: Tin Street became the site of numerous celebrations marking the hard-won victory.

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The notorious Tin Street Kingpin whose goblins run rackets there.
relations.quote: Goblins loyal to Krenko , the notorious Tin Street Kingpin, prowl the alleys and rooftops
